description: Simulated cloud failure telemetry datasets for QA pipeline validation

scenarios.name: RDS Connection Pool Exhaustion & Cascading 503
scenarios.expectedRootCause: Database connection pool exhaustion on RDS instance caused by high CPU bottleneck, leading to backend authentication failure and downstream ALB 503 errors.

telemetrySequence.message: Connection pool exhausted, max_connections limit reached
/api/v1/login endpoint failed with 500 Internal Server Error
HTTP 503 Service Unavailable: No healthy targets in target group

scenarios.name: AWS Lambda Memory Saturation & CloudWatch Alarm
scenarios.expectedRootCause: Lambda invocation duration limit breached due to memory saturation during image processing, triggering CloudWatch alarm and upstream timeout.

scenarios.name: EC2 Out Of Memory (OOM Killer) & Process Termination
scenarios.expectedRootCause: Linux kernel OOM killer terminated the Spring Boot JVM process (PID 1420) due to memory starvation, failing ALB target health checks.

telemetrySequence.message: Out of memory: Kill process 1420 (java) score 950 or sacrifice child
spring-boot.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
Health check failed for target i-0abcd1234efgh5678
